name: Laura Loomer
role: American far-right activist, commentator and Trump ally; congressional candidate in Florida (2020, 2022)
summary: Loomer is a pro-Trump, pro-Israel activist whose public statements center on opposition to immigration and to Islam and Muslims in public life, and on complaints about online censorship. She has described herself as an ethnonationalist and as a proud Islamophobe. Her recorded positions on economics, healthcare, guns, abortion and social policy are thin in her own words.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Replied to a congresswoman in 2025: 'There's no such thing as Hate Speech' (reported in s1).

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Frames immigrants who do not assimilate as a threat to American heritage (s1) and says Europe was transformed by unchecked Islamic immigration (s6).

reduce-immigration.rationale: Said in a 2017 interview that immigration and calls for diversity are 'starting to destroy this country' (s4); later said she wants 'all Islamic immigrants deported' and attacks mass migration (s1, s6).

open-borders.rationale: Attacked 'open borders' policies in her 2017 interview (s4) and calls for deportations (s1).

ethnic-nation.rationale: In 2017 said 'I totally support ethnonationalism', that the US 'was built as a white, Judeo-Christian ethnostate' and 'I don't oppose people who say that they want to have their own ethnostate' (s4); statement from 2017, with Israel cited as her example.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Calls herself pro-Israel (s4) and says 'Israel is a Jewish state' that is entitled to its own policies (s3).

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Reported as saying immigrants who refuse to assimilate threaten American heritage (s1); also says Muslims who 'come into your country' want to impose their own laws (s6).

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Said 'I am opposed to Muslim people holding public office' (s6) and in 2019 that Muslims should not be allowed to seek political office (s1); in 2017 said Palestinians are 'not legitimate people' (s4). Also said 'I don't hate Muslim people' (s6).

population-transfer.rationale: Reported calling for deportation of 'every Muslim in America' (May 2026) and of 'all Islamic immigrants' (s1); said she opposes Muslims holding public office (s6).

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Said that 'immigration, and all these calls for diversity, it's starting to destroy this country' (s4).

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Says 'I am firmly opposed to Islam' and that Europe was radically transformed by Islamic immigration (s6); has called Islam a 'cancer' (s1). Framed around religion rather than civilizations generally, so low.

native-born-offices.rationale: Reported as saying 'I think you can only serve in office if you were actually born in this country.'

islam-incompatible.rationale: In a Jerusalem Post interview she called Islam 'a very archaic, barbaric ideology' and said there is 'no moderate form of Islam'; she also warned of the 'Islamification' of America.
